title: Verify that if headers contains white  spacing before and after column name and header should not consider casing.
preconditions:
1.URL must be working
2.user should be on FMS home page

steps.action: Go to Extraction & Load Layer -> Column Configuration
steps.expectedResult: User should redirect to the list page
Pop up window for file upload should open

steps.action: Now upload the file in which header contains white space  before and after headers name and and name is different type of casing
